prompt: A model achieves 95% accuracy on a dataset where 95% of samples are class 'A'. What is the problem?
choices: 95% accuracy is always excellent — deploy the model immediately
The model might predict class 'A' for everything (majority class baseline) and have no real predictive power
The dataset is too small at 95% to be useful
explanation: On imbalanced datasets, a naive model that always predicts the majority class matches the base rate. 95% accuracy here might mean zero recall for class 'B'. Use: precision, recall, F1-score, or AUC-ROC instead of raw accuracy for imbalanced data.
